recipe_version.title: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Boil with Corn and Andouille
recipe_version.description: All the flavor of a Lowcountry boil without the boil: Old Bay–seasoned baby potatoes, red onion, corn rounds, and smoky andouille roast until browned, then garlic-Old Bay butter shrimp go on for the last few minutes. Finished with lemon and parsley, straight from the pans.

ingredients.name: baby potatoes
ingredients.display_name: baby red or Yukon Gold potatoes

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.preparation: cut through the root into 8 wedges

ingredients.name: corn on the cob
ingredients.note: 4 ears; or 12 frozen mini cobs, thawed and patted dry
ingredients.preparation: husked and cut into 3 rounds each

ingredients.name: andouille sausage
ingredients.display_name: fully cooked smoked pork andouille sausage
ingredients.note: Pork (meat). HARD CONTRACT: pork andouille (not chicken andouille) whose label allergen statement lists no wheat or soy; most smoked pork andouille does not. Choose another andouille if it does.
ingredients.preparation: sliced into 1/2-inch coins on a slight bias

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.display_name: large shrimp (21/25 per lb), peeled and deveined, tails on
ingredients.preparation: thawed if frozen and patted very dry

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: 1 1/2 tbsp potatoes and onion, 1/2 tbsp corn

ingredients.name: Old Bay seasoning
ingredients.note: Store-bought seafood spice blend. Divided: 2 tsp potatoes/onion, 1 tsp corn, 1 tbsp in the shrimp butter. Salty; added salt is kept low.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: potatoes and onion only; Old Bay seasons the rest

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: Milk. Melted with the garlic and tossed with the shrimp.

ingredients.name: lemons
ingredients.preparation: 1 halved for squeezing, 1 cut into wedges

steps.title: Heat the oven and prep
steps.body: Set racks in the upper and lower thirds of the oven and heat it to 425 F; it preheats while you prep (about 15 minutes). Halve the potatoes and cut the onion into wedges. Husk the corn and cut each ear into 3 rounds with a heavy knife (rock the blade through the cob). Slice the andouille. Pat the shrimp very dry. Mince the garlic, chop the parsley, halve one lemon, and cut the other into wedges. About 15 minutes.

clock.note: oven preheat to 425 F runs inside this block

steps.title: Roast the potatoes and onion
steps.body: On two rimmed half-sheet pans, toss the potatoes and onion with 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp Old Bay, and the 1/2 tsp kosher salt. Spread out, potatoes cut side down. Roast 15 minutes. About 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add the corn and andouille
steps.body: Toss the corn rounds with the remaining 1/2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp Old Bay. Add the corn and andouille to the pans, nestling them among the potatoes, then switch the pans between racks. Roast 10 minutes, until the potatoes are nearly tender and browned underneath and the sausage is sizzling. During the last 2 minutes, put the butter and garlic in a large microwave-safe bowl and microwave 45 to 60 seconds until melted and sizzling; stir in 1 tbsp Old Bay and add the shrimp, tossing to coat (overlaps the roast; adds no time). About 10 minutes.

clock.note: shrimp-butter toss overlaps the last 2 minutes of this roast

steps.title: Roast the shrimp
steps.body: Spoon the buttered shrimp onto the pans in a single layer among the vegetables and drizzle any garlic butter left in the bowl over the corn. Roast 6 to 7 minutes, until the shrimp are pink, opaque, and curled into loose C shapes (145 F) and the potatoes are fork-tender. About 7 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with lemon and parsley
steps.body: Squeeze the halved lemon over both pans, scatter the parsley, and tuck in the lemon wedges. Serve straight from the pans or pile everything onto a platter. About 3 minutes. kitchen_tested is false.

components.name: Old Bay roasted potatoes, onion, corn, and andouille

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15 (oven preheats to 425 F during prep). Cook 35 = 15 potatoes/onion + 10 corn/andouille (shrimp-butter toss overlaps the last 2 minutes) + 7 shrimp + 3 finish.
recipe_version.heat: Oven 425 F, racks in upper and lower thirds, preheated during the 15-minute prep. Pans switch racks when the corn goes in. Microwave only to melt the garlic butter.
recipe_version.doneness: Potatoes fork-tender and browned on the cut side; corn kernels spotted golden; andouille browned at the edges; shrimp pink, opaque, loosely C-shaped (145 F), not tightly curled. kitchen_tested is false.

No egg, wheat, soy, sesame, peanut, tree_nut, finfish, or poultry.
